fact: RSTP reports that the third Empreende+ competition is run by the Ministry of Economy and Finance with the REINA incubator in the city of Sao Tome, which takes applications from 24 July to 16 August 2026, followed by training and mentoring; the document names no cohort of startups.

REINA, the São Tomé and Príncipe network of business incubators and accelerators, with PNUD support ran the second Empreende+ competition: 33 of over 150 applicants got five weeks of intensive training and nine reached the final, with four funded.
